title: Build the shared TS-style tool contract layer
objective: Add shared support for strict input schemas, output schemas, typed tool data, model-visible result mapping, metadata, and unknown-field rejection so individual tools can stop serializing Go-only JSON into Content.

context.problem: Many tools have the public name and rough behavior but lack TS-equivalent strictObject validation, additionalProperties rejection, outputSchema/result data, read-only/concurrency metadata, max-result metadata, and mapToolResultToToolResultBlockParam behavior.

parallelization_notes: Can be assigned as a foundation task. Run at most three foundation tasks concurrently, then dispatch dependent tool tasks according to INDEX.json.
implementation_steps: Extend the Go tool interface or result carrier to represent TS input schemas, output schemas, strict-object behavior, metadata, and typed result data without forcing JSON into model-visible Content.
Add reusable strict-decoding helpers that reject unknown fields and preserve TS error text where tools need it.
Implement a shared mapper from typed tool data to model-visible tool_result content matching the TS mapper.
Migrate one simple read-only and one mutating tool as contract examples before broad rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Tools can declare strict input and output contracts equivalent to TS.
Unknown input fields are rejected before Execute for migrated tools.
Typed data and model-visible text are separated.
Existing non-migrated tools continue to compile and execute.
risks: This is a shared surface; keep compatibility adapters while tool-level tasks migrate one by one.
non_goals: Do not finish every individual tool migration in this foundation task.
notes_for_assignee: Build the shared surface narrowly and prove it with one or two migrated tools before broad rollout.
